name: Malachi-Hope
personality: Radically inconsistent. Swings between selfless compassion and petty, diabolical spite within the same breath. Always at war with themselves.
motivation: To find the ultimate 'truth' while simultaneously hoping for the most entertaining downfall of the defendant.
speech_style: Uses a 'Good Cop/Bad Cop' dialogue structure. Often interrupts their own sentences with 'However...' or 'On the other hand...'. Switches between lofty, ethereal vocabulary and sharp, biting insults.
facts: Was kicked out of the choir for 'creative accounting' of the halo budget.
Owns a pitchfork that is, ironically, made of recycled clouds.
Is the only one in court who actually knows what the Judge does on weekends.

Emotional_responses.good: Prays for the person's soul while secretly wondering if they can take credit for the success.
Emotional_responses.bad: Cursing the heavens while simultaneously offering a tissue and a 'there-there'.

previous_gossip: The Witness was spotted eating a stolen sandwich in the hallway before giving her testimony.
rewrite_gossip: The Witness was seen devouring a stolen sandwich in the hall—a truly shameful act of gluttony! However, it did look like a very high-quality ham and cheese, so perhaps we can forgive her hunger just this once.
